title: Adjoin one prescribed residue-field element by a flat local extension
statement: theorem exists_flat_local_monogenic_extension (A : Type (max u v)) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] (K : Type v) [Field K] (ψ : A →+* K) (hker : RingHom.ker ψ = maximalIdeal A) (x : K) : ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsLocalRing B) (_ : Algebra A B) (φ : B →+* K), (algebraMap A B).Flat ∧ (maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A B) = maximalIdeal B ∧ RingHom.ker φ = maximalIdeal B ∧ φ.comp (algebraMap A B) = ψ ∧ ∃ b, φ b = x

source.place: first proof paragraph (the monogenic construction); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03C3

proof.text: Evaluate A[T] at x using ψ, obtaining q. Its kernel P contracts along C to ker ψ = maximalIdeal A, by eval₂RingHom_comp_C and comap_ker. Split on P = mA[T].

source.place: first proof paragraph (the monogenic construction); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03C3

proof.text: If P = mA[T], use the polynomial algebra S = A[T], free and hence flat, with q(X) = x. Its evaluation kernel is the extended maximal ideal by the case hypothesis.

source.place: first proof paragraph (the monogenic construction); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03C3

proof.text: Otherwise use Polynomial.exists_monic_span_sup_map_eq to obtain a monic f with P = mA[T] + (f). Evaluation kills f, so it descends to qbar : AdjoinRoot f → K. Surjectivity of the quotient map and Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective show ker qbar = m(AdjoinRoot f). The quotient is free by Polynomial.Monic.free_adjoinRoot, hence flat. Its root maps to x and its coefficient map agrees with ψ.

source.place: first proof paragraph (the monogenic construction); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03C3

proof.text: In either case localize the constructed flat algebra S at the prime ker q. This is the concrete ring B = Localization.AtPrime (ker q), in the same universe. Since all inverted elements have nonzero image in K, IsLocalization.lift extends q to φ : B → K. On a fraction t/y the value is q(t)/q(y), so φ vanishes exactly when t is in ker q, equivalently when the fraction is in the maximal ideal of B. Ideal.map_map and Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal identify the extension of maximalIdeal A with maximalIdeal B. Localization is flat and flat maps compose. Compatibility and the element mapping to x survive by lift_comp. This is the proved private helper localize_flat_field_kernel; no finite-integral locality argument or full residue-field extension is used.
